menu_option_descriptions.redirect_login: Log in through your browser and paste back the authorization code. Use this method.
menu_option_descriptions.direct_login: Enter email and password directly. Usually fails now that Lynk & Co requires a CAPTCHA – only try this if Browser Login does not work for you.

redirect_login.title: Browser Login
redirect_login.description:
1. Open this URL in a desktop browser and complete the login (password, CAPTCHA and any 2FA):

{auth_url}

2. After the final step the browser tries to open a link starting with `msauth://` and shows an error page – this is expected.
3. Copy that `msauth://...` link. It is usually shown in the address bar; if not, open the developer tools (F12) → Network tab, find the request to `msauth://...` and copy its URL.
4. Paste it below. You may paste the whole `msauth://...?code=...` link or just the `code` value on its own.

reauth.title: Re-authentication Required
reauth.description: Please re-enter your credentials to re-authenticate.

error.invalid_redirect_uri: No authorization code could be found in what you pasted. Paste the full msauth:// link or just the code value and try again.
error.invalid_email: The provided email is invalid. Please check and try again.
error.invalid_2fa_code: The provided 2FA code is invalid. Please check and try again.
error.login_failed: Login failed. Please check your credentials and try again.
